limitations.evidence: 674/2000 verified; prediction-time verification propensity AUROC 0.740; material SMD/KS differences
limitations.consequence: Primary performance applies only to the deterministically verifiable subset
limitations.action_taken: Cross-fitted propensity and truncated IPW sensitivity analyses
limitations.remaining_limitation: MAR is untestable and weights do not identify missing outcomes

limitations.evidence: 50 selected -> 18 endpoint verified -> 16 A2/H0 paired -> 5 positive events
limitations.action_taken: Separated endpoint, schema, and intersection attrition in a machine-readable funnel
limitations.remaining_limitation: Requires a new untouched period with a much larger Agent cohort

limitations.issue: The tested Local Agent is a 0.5B Q4 model, not an LLM capability ceiling
limitations.evidence: Only qwen2.5:0.5b was locally installed; the later Codex comparator did not expose an exact model identity
limitations.consequence: Negative Agent findings cannot generalize to stronger models
limitations.action_taken: Audited wording, kept stronger-local and external GPT-5 studies NOT_TESTED, and reported the separate Codex comparator only as POST_HOC
limitations.remaining_limitation: A frozen, exactly identified stronger-model comparison must occur in E5

limitations.issue: E4 endpoint is a financial-deterioration proxy
limitations.consequence: Results do not validate bankruptcy, default, credit loss, or insolvency probability
limitations.remaining_limitation: A distinct adjudicated default endpoint requires a separate study

limitations.issue: Full narrative/document Agent was not evaluated
limitations.evidence: FSDS packets lack full MD&A, Risk Factors, footnotes, and auditor narrative
limitations.consequence: No document grounding, contradiction, planner, reflection, or full-Agent external-validation claim is supported
limitations.action_taken: Retained NOT_TESTED evidence status and drafted E5 narrative track
limitations.remaining_limitation: Requires a frozen narrative corpus and adjudicated claims

limitations.issue: Continuous Agent scores are batch-context sensitive
limitations.evidence: Mean absolute batch-single delta 0.101; median 0.010; p95 0.418; max 0.770; Spearman 0.314; Kendall 0.313
limitations.consequence: High 96.6% binary agreement masks unstable ranking
limitations.action_taken: Added full distribution, rank correlations, flips, and size-2 post-hoc analysis
limitations.remaining_limitation: E5 must freeze batch size and test context sensitivity before outcomes

limitations.issue: Five schema failures were not root-cause identifiable
limitations.evidence: All were A2 TypeError records without invalid response payload retention
limitations.consequence: Failure taxonomy cannot be reconstructed for E4
limitations.action_taken: Added deterministic schema error codes and response/hash retention for future runs
limitations.remaining_limitation: Original five E4 failures remain unresolved AGENT_FAILED

limitations.evidence: Large descriptive ECE/CITL deviations, especially Agent scores; calibration used E4 labels only post hoc
limitations.consequence: Scores cannot be interpreted as probabilities
limitations.action_taken: Generated descriptive reliability, Brier, ECE, and slope diagnostics
limitations.remaining_limitation: Requires an independent calibration split and later untouched validation

limitations.issue: Frozen SEC-Zenodo concordance used last-write-wins without exact period matching
limitations.evidence: 1185/1624 >5% mismatches had period mismatch; 17 involved duplicate candidates
limitations.consequence: The frozen 90.9% is source concordance only and has avoidable matching ambiguity
limitations.action_taken: Future code now requires exact period and rejects conflicting duplicates; added test
limitations.remaining_limitation: Frozen E4 concordance is unchanged; taxonomy/restatement causes remain partly unresolved

limitations.issue: H0 equal weighting is transparent but not empirically selected
limitations.evidence: H0 fixed 0.5/0.5; only 16 paired observations and 5 events
limitations.action_taken: Generated explicitly post-hoc 0.0-1.0 weight grid without replacing H0
limitations.remaining_limitation: E5 weight must be chosen from historical development data and frozen

limitations.issue: Original environment manifest did not enumerate the full host package and Docker environment
limitations.evidence: Agent/model digests were frozen, but OS, CPU architecture, Docker engine, and all package versions were not collected together
limitations.consequence: Exact host recreation is harder although canonical replay succeeds
limitations.remaining_limitation: Post-hoc capture cannot prove every execution-time host detail was unchanged

limitations.issue: No prospectively untouched reserve cohort exists
limitations.evidence: E4 outcomes are visible and unused eligible companies were not frozen as an outcome-blind reserve
limitations.consequence: Unused E4 companies cannot be relabeled as confirmatory
limitations.action_taken: E5 protocol requires a new time window and pre-outcome freeze
limitations.remaining_limitation: Confirmation must wait for future data

limitations.issue: The Codex comparator runtime identity and platform prompt were not exposed
limitations.evidence: The platform exposed neither an exact sub-Agent model ID nor a complete system-prompt/runtime attestation
limitations.consequence: The frozen outputs are auditable, but the inference call is not independently byte-reproducible and cannot support a named-model capability claim
limitations.action_taken: Used ChatGPT5.6 Sol only as a disclosed project-internal codename and marked every result POST_HOC
limitations.remaining_limitation: E5 requires an exact model ID, provider/runtime attestation, and frozen controllable prompt before prediction
